artworks.title: Giant-Sized Valentine
artworks.description: I created this project to commemorate my last Palentine's (aka Valentine's Day for just the Pals) before moving from my home of a half-decade. I attached this envelope to the hook on our front door, and filled it full of letters for all my Pals. Then, when everyone came over for our V-day card making party, they were each greeted with a special note. As someone whose main love language is writing and sending mail, this Big Envelope filled me with so much joy to both craft and fill with letters.

artworks.title: Handmade Paper
artworks.description: My husband and I made this paper together! We used a combination of recycled paper to create a unique texture and color. Each sheet is one-of-a-kind, and perfect for writing letters or creating art.
